scheme.title: Relation
scheme.description: How a related resource relates to this one (DataCite relation types, subset).

concepts.label: Is supplement to
concepts.description: This resource supplements the related one (e.g. data behind an article).

concepts.label: Is documented by
concepts.description: The related resource documents this one.

concepts.label: Is supplemented by
concepts.description: The related resource supplements this one (e.g. a style file, a legend).

concepts.label: Is derived from
concepts.description: This resource was produced from the related one.

concepts.label: Is source of
concepts.description: The related resource was produced from this one.

concepts.label: Is part of
concepts.description: This resource belongs to the related one.

concepts.label: Has part
concepts.description: The related resource belongs to this one.

concepts.label: Is new version of
concepts.description: This resource replaces an earlier release.

concepts.label: Is previous version of
concepts.description: This resource was replaced by the related one.

concepts.label: Is cited by
concepts.description: The related resource cites this one.

concepts.label: References
concepts.description: This resource references the related one.

concepts.label: Is variant form of
concepts.description: Same content in another format or packaging.
